comparison.objective: Straighten a training doll’s sprung legs and close a footboard to measure length.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained limb restraint plus board closure, not tool-on-tool impact or brittle notch separation.
comparison.success_condition: Legs held flat, footboard left at the reading, then released; no fragment containment or retained fastener test.
comparison.reason: The shared bimanual stabilization primitive does not make the measurement task an overlap. No specs or numeric scoring tolerances are available.
